result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: Client retains its content, IP and data; owns defined Work Product through a present assignment; receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP; and avoids joint ownership. TrueLink’s ownership of the Interface remains intact, preserving its pre-existing platform IP and unrelated commercial terms. The amendment is targeted and professionally drafted, though placement after Section 13 and the limitation of Work Product to items prepared under the Support Services could be clarified if deliverables may arise under other services.
